decision_timing: recorded before implementing or measuring the selected v2 distribution

h100_high_attempt_estimate.use: acceptance-probability estimate only; forbidden as a pilot solution

options.name: increase_rejection_attempt_limit
options.reason: does not remove duration-dependent time compression or horizon-dependent conditioning; 0 of 2048 H100 candidates accepted

options.name: horizon_dependent_amplitude_or_frequency_limits
options.reason: no single amplitude scaling preserves position, velocity, acceleration, and jerk together; risks short-horizon degeneration and changes the task distribution by horizon

options.name: constructive_coefficient_scaling_or_projection
options.reason: can force feasibility but creates a new pushforward distribution with bound-mass and horizon-dependent scaling bias that would need a separate study

options.name: fixed_support_parent_with_horizon_prefixes
options.reason: one physical time basis, one accepted parent distribution, exact prefix comparability, and exact H400 legacy candidate preservation are testable

options.name: new_stationary_process_or_spline_family
options.reason: scientifically plausible but less backward-compatible and larger than the minimum change needed to resolve the measured blocker

selected_distribution.parent_validation: all documented constraints are evaluated on the complete 4-second parent before slicing
selected_distribution.explicit_tradeoff: prefixes shorter than four seconds are not forced to return to hover at their endpoint

technical: no nonfinite value and every documented parent constraint passes
same accepted attempt index for each paired seed at H100, H200, and H400
H100 and H200 arrays are exact prefixes of paired H400 arrays
paired v2 H400 arrays and attempt indices exactly match legacy v1 H400
a fresh repeated process has the same timing-excluded scientific payload SHA-256

diversity.basis: configured amplitudes and limits plus the pre-measured accepted legacy H200/H400 distributions
diversity.v2_H400: exact paired legacy-v1 equality, not only a threshold

claim_boundary: Passing is an empirical construction gate for the fixed CPU research path, not proof of the full distribution, optimization quality, GPU readiness, Sim2Real, hardware, or safety.
